sql: SELECT 'F' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side||'/'||f.action||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity||' fee '||f.fee||' @'||(f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time')||' ing '||to_char(f.filled_at,'HH24:MI:SS') d FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' UNION ALL SELECT 'O', market_ticker, status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'-')||' '||side||'/'||action||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||left(client_order_id,14)||' '||to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' UNION ALL SELECT 'P', market_ticker, to_char(captured_at,'HH24:MI')||' '||quantity_fp::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, quantity_fp FROM positions WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' AND captured_at > now()-interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) p UNION ALL SELECT 'S', market_ticker, to_char(at,'HH24:MI')||' yb '||coalesce(best_yes_bid::text,'-')||' nb '||coalesce(best_no_bid::text,'-') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, at, best_yes_bid, best_no_bid FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' AND at > now()-interval '3 hours' ORDER BY market_ticker, at DESC) s ORDER BY 1,2
